simulation.decision_rule: reject H0 when abs(z) exceeds the two-sided alpha=0.05 normal critical value; attrition is simulated as missing pre-analysis and the paired mean is tested with cluster-robust CR1-style variance
simulation.ci: two-sided 95 percent normal interval for the simulated paired mean
simulation.gate: baseline empirical power must be at least 0.90 and a one-sided 95 percent normal-approximation lower confidence bound over the Monte-Carlo power estimate must be at least 0.89

justification.discordance_q: Conservative planning grid covering 0.30-0.45 total paired discordance; no confirmatory data were inspected.
justification.icc: Sensitivity grid spans weak to moderate within-source-family correlation because exact confirmatory clustering is not yet observable before corpus construction.
justification.attrition: 0.05 baseline and 0.10 stress cover malformed/runtime/exclusion risk for capacity planning only; actual primary failures remain governed by the frozen failure contract.
justification.effect: 0.08 is the preregistered smallest practically meaningful absolute gain; 0.05 and 0.10 are sensitivity values, not alternate primary claims.
